articles.headline: Tuchel: DNA of English football needs changing after World Cup semifinal collapse
articles.description: England boss Thomas Tuchel says the DNA of English football needs changing if his side are to win major tournaments -- and insists he is "100%" committed to staying in the job.

articles.headline: Ibrahimović: England players must 'look in the mirror' after World Cup exit
articles.description: Zlatan Ibrahimovic has told England's players to "look in the mirror" and ask "how good you really are" after the Three Lions suffered their latest failure to reach a World Cup final with defeat to Argentina.

articles.headline: UK urges FIFA investigation of Argentina over Falklands banner
articles.description: The British government on Thursday urged FIFA to investigate Argentina's team after players celebrating their 2-1 win over England in the World Cup semifinals posed with a banner that claimed sovereignty over the contest

articles.headline: England midfielder Bellingham slaps Argentina's Barco on the head after World Cup semifinal exit
articles.description: England midfielder Jude Bellingham slapped the back of Argentina player Valentín Barco's head after their World Cup semifinal defeat in Atlanta.
